headline: NFL Hands Rams LT Alaric Jackson Two-Game Suspension
summary: Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb after Buffalo defeated Los Angeles on Monday night. The NFL reviewed the incident and has decided to suspend Jackson two games without pay, Aaron Wilson of KPRC2 reports. The league has since announced the ban. headline: Niners LB Dre Greenlaw's appeal of suspension rejected, will sit vs. Commanders
summary: Niners linebacker Dre Greenlaw will serve his one-game suspension in Monday night's game against the Commanders after the NFL denied his appeal Tuesday.
